mapper.select: SELECT c.*, cu.name as customer_name, cu.email as customer_email, cu.loyalty_level as customer_loyalty_level FROM shopping_cart.shopping_carts c LEFT JOIN shopping_cart.customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.id ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.*, cu.name as customer_name, cu.email as customer_email, cu.loyalty_level as customer_loyalty_level FROM shopping_cart.shopping_carts c LEFT JOIN shopping_cart.customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id as cart_id, c.status as cart_status, c.total_amount as cart_total_amount, c.created_at as cart_created_at, c.updated_at as cart_updated_at, cu.id as customer_id, cu.name as customer_name, cu.email as customer_email, cu.loyalty_level as customer_loyalty_level, ci.id as item_id, ci.quantity as item_quantity, ci.unit_price as item_unit_price, ci.total_price as item_total_price, ci.created_at as item_created_at, ci.updated_at as item_updated_at, p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, p.category as product_category, p.price as product_price, p.description as product_description, p.stock_quantity as product_stock_quantity FROM shopping_cart.shopping_carts c LEFT JOIN shopping_cart.customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.id LEFT JOIN shopping_cart.cart_items ci ON c.id = ci.cart_id LEFT JOIN shopping_cart.products p ON ci.product_id = p.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.*, cu.name as customer_name, cu.email as customer_email, cu.loyalty_level as customer_loyalty_level FROM shopping_cart.shopping_carts c LEFT JOIN shopping_cart.customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.id WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.*, cu.name as customer_name, cu.email as customer_email, cu.loyalty_level as customer_loyalty_level FROM shopping_cart.shopping_carts c LEFT JOIN shopping_cart.customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.id WHERE c.status = #{status} ORDER BY c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_cart.shopping_carts (customer_id, status, total_amount, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{customer.id}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
